lines.text: I've watched every brave person who ever walked past this clock.
Not one of them felt brave first.
So… five steps. And the last one sounds backwards. It isn't.
Five. Name the fear out loud. Fear hates being called by its name.
Four. Shrink the step until it's almost silly. Then take it.
Three. Borrow courage from someone who believes in you.
Two. Count to five, then move before your mind argues.
One. Stop waiting to feel ready. Courage isn't a feeling. It's what you do while you're scared.
lines.delivery: Quiet at first, rising to conviction.

lines.text: Bravery only ever comes… after the first step.
